description: Create a pull request from the current branch for pitwall, into the right base for this repo's two-tier flow — feature branches (`dev-<feature>`) target `dev`, and `dev` itself targets `master` as a release PR. Analyzes the new commits, drafts a PR title and a Summary/Test-plan body matching this repo's existing PR style, previews it for approval, then creates it via the `gh` CLI. A release PR into `master` additionally settles the version and writes the release notes file before the tag exists. Use whenever the user says "pr", "pull request", "open a pr", "create pr", "ship it", "merge into dev", "merge into master", "cut a release", "raise a pr", or anything about getting the current branch merged — even if they don't say the word "skill".
